svg.title: BCH BLAZE 2026: pay-per-use AI powered by Bitcoin Cash
svg.desc: Animated flow: login, wallet connect, prompt, BCH micro-payment, AI insight and delivery, running on a Node.js and Express API with PostgreSQL and Prisma.

g.text: AI crypto market insights where every request is paid with a BCH micro-payment. No subscription.
Verifies the BCH payment, calls the AI, stores every result.
Pay only for what you use
Built solo, shipped end to end
